ui.chat.device.label.moving_to.role: device chip visible label while a move is in flight
ui.chat.device.label.moving_to.tone: verb phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.device.label.moving_to.length: Four words plus the device name.
ui.chat.device.label.moving_to.note: The chip's visible text in the chat header while this pane's move has not been confirmed. It must stay short enough to sit in the title block; keep the device name in the placeholder. The chip truncates at narrow widths; maxCells is an advisory translation target, not measured fit.

placeholders.name: the other device's display name, as the user gave it. Keep it verbatim; never translate a device name.

ui.chat.device.label.new_on.role: device chip visible label for a draft created on another device
ui.chat.device.label.new_on.tone: noun phrase with the tense marker `New`, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.device.label.new_on.length: Three words plus the device name.
ui.chat.device.label.new_on.note: The word `New` is the whole defence against reading the chip as a live session: the conversation does not exist yet and WILL be created there. Do not drop or soften the tense marker. The chip truncates at narrow widths; maxCells is an advisory translation target, not measured fit.

placeholders.name: the other device's display name, as the user gave it. Keep it verbatim; never translate a device name.

ui.chat.device.label.new_on_this_device.role: device chip visible label for a draft created on this machine
ui.chat.device.label.new_on_this_device.tone: noun phrase with the tense marker `New`, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.device.label.new_on_this_device.note: Same tense rule as the other draft arm: nothing exists yet. `this device` is the local machine. The chip truncates at narrow widths; maxCells is an advisory translation target, not measured fit.

ui.chat.device.label.on.role: device chip visible label for a live conversation on another device
ui.chat.device.label.on.tone: prepositional phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.device.label.on.length: Two words plus the device name.
ui.chat.device.label.on.note: Contrasts with `New on …`: this conversation exists and runs there. Keep the device name in the placeholder. The chip truncates at narrow widths; maxCells is an advisory translation target, not measured fit.

placeholders.name: the other device's display name, as the user gave it. Keep it verbatim; never translate a device name.

ui.chat.device.label.on_this_device.role: device chip visible label for a live conversation on this machine
ui.chat.device.label.on_this_device.tone: prepositional phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.device.label.on_this_device.note: This conversation exists and runs here. Must not be used for a draft; the draft arm carries `New`. The chip truncates at narrow widths; maxCells is an advisory translation target, not measured fit.

ui.chat.device.sentence.draft_elsewhere.role: accessible name and tooltip of the device chip on a draft
ui.chat.device.sentence.draft_elsewhere.tone: two short sentences: the placement, then what a press does
ui.chat.device.sentence.draft_elsewhere.note: Read by screen readers and shown on hover. Names where the new conversation will be created and the affordance; keep the device name in the placeholder.

placeholders.name: the other device's display name, as the user gave it. Keep it verbatim; never translate a device name.

ui.chat.device.sentence.draft_here.role: accessible name and tooltip of the device chip on a draft created here
ui.chat.device.sentence.draft_here.tone: two short sentences: the placement, then what a press does
ui.chat.device.sentence.draft_here.note: Same affordance as the other draft arm, naming this machine.

ui.chat.device.sentence.gone.role: accessible name and tooltip of the chip for a conversation that moved away
ui.chat.device.sentence.gone.tone: three short sentences: where it went, what was deleted, what a press does
ui.chat.device.sentence.gone.note: The local copy of this conversation was deleted by the move, so the chip is a tombstone. The press brings the conversation back here; do not promise opening it on the peer.

placeholders.name: the other device's display name, as the user gave it. Keep it verbatim; never translate a device name.

ui.chat.device.sentence.gone_did_not_ans.role: accessible name and tooltip of the moved-away chip after an unanswered read
ui.chat.device.sentence.gone_did_not_ans.tone: statement of the unanswered read, then the deletion and the press
ui.chat.device.sentence.gone_did_not_ans.note: An unanswered read is not an offline device: nobody asked since the move. Do not read it as a failure or a verdict.

placeholders.name: the other device's display name, as the user gave it. Keep it verbatim; never translate a device name.

ui.chat.device.sentence.local.role: accessible name and tooltip of the chip for a local live conversation
ui.chat.device.sentence.local.tone: two sentences: where it runs, then both directions the press offers
ui.chat.device.sentence.local.note: Names both halves of the affordance: move it elsewhere now, or recall it later. Do not shorten to only `move`, which would hide the recall.

ui.chat.device.sentence.moving.role: accessible name and tooltip of the chip while a move is in flight
ui.chat.device.sentence.moving.length: Six words plus the device name.
ui.chat.device.sentence.moving.note: Used as the live-region and tooltip sentence while the backend has not confirmed the move.

placeholders.name: the other device's display name, as the user gave it. Keep it verbatim; never translate a device name.

ui.chat.device.sentence.remote.role: accessible name and tooltip of the chip for a live conversation on another device
ui.chat.device.sentence.remote.tone: two sentences: where it runs, then what a press does
ui.chat.device.sentence.remote.note: The chip's visible words cannot say this; keep the device name in the placeholder.

placeholders.name: the other device's display name, as the user gave it. Keep it verbatim; never translate a device name.

ui.chat.device.sentence.remote_did_not_a.role: accessible name and tooltip of the remote chip after an unanswered read
ui.chat.device.sentence.remote_did_not_a.note: The last read did not answer; that is not the same as the device being offline, so do not add a failure word.

placeholders.name: the other device's display name, as the user gave it. Keep it verbatim; never translate a device name.

ui.chat.device.sentence.remote_did_not_a.role: accessible name and tooltip of the remote chip after an unanswered read, with the backend's reason
ui.chat.device.sentence.remote_did_not_a.note: The parenthesised reason is the backend's own sentence and arrives verbatim; never translate it or drop the parentheses.

placeholders.name: the other device's display name, as the user gave it. Keep it verbatim; never translate a device name.
placeholders.reason: the backend's own reason sentence for an unanswered read. Keep the parentheses; never translate the reason text.
